notes: Closed named OSM raceway retained as a course candidate. Named-layout association requires review.
Source way order and shared node IDs are retained. No nearby endpoints are joined and no reference boundaries are read.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 70 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

supersedes.reason: Original borders contain pavement-crossing spikes or local self-crossings at the pinned defect vertices. The native licensed image, full appearance-estimator overlay and original defect crop were reviewed against the retained source route. The complete automatic replacement remains estimated, with image sampling, shadows, shoulders, paint and access-opening uncertainty. It is not a surveyed barrier or an independent manual measurement recipe.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been formally verified; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.
